sections.text: M/u TDS and tested new cutter at surface. Disconnected TDS
Removed master bushing and installed PS-21 slips
RIH w/ cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from surface to 820 m. Avg. Tripping speed 470 m/hr. Avg.
Filled pipe 800 LPM. Reduced rate to 200lpm when pipe was full

Recorded parameters 600lpm 68 bar, 400 LPM 35 bar. Took up/down weight 95/90 ton. 1-6 KNM free rot. Torque. Cut casing at 820 mmd, 80 RPM 600 LPM. Saw pressure drop, indiaction of cut. MAX torque when cutting 17 KNM.
Flowchecked well for 10 min, static.
Measured cut window, 80cm.
Disconnected TDS and POOH on 5 1/2" DP. Avg. Tripping speed 510 m/hr.
Removed PS-21 slips and installed master bushing l/d cutter BHA. String magnet covered in swarf.
Cleaned and cleared drill floor.
Performed TBT for honing CH area
P/u and m/u milling BHA
RIH w/ milling BHA from surface to 135m.
Filled pipe and recorded parameters, 80 RPM/1-4 KNM, up/down weight 80/77 ton, 2000 LPM/9BAR. RIH and tagget obstuction at 141,5m with 1 ton.
Honed obstruction in CH area, 100 RPM/2-20 KNM, 2000 LPM/9BAR. RIH with 12 1/4" stab below CH.
Performed TBT for POOH
POOH w/ milling BHA
L/d milling BHA
Prepared for clean-out run. Cleaned and cleared drill floor.
Performed TBT for m/u and RIH with clean-out BHA
M/u clean-out BHA
Removed master bushing and installed PS-21 slips
RIH w/ clean-out BHA from 67 mmd to 806 mmd. Avg. Running speed 740 m/hr.

Filled pipe and staged up pumps to 3100 LPM/36 bar. OBM in returns, got a gas peak of 18 and 8ppm h2s in return fluid. Staged up pumps to 4000lpm 58 bar made 4 passes with flow and rotation between 806 mmd and 815 mmd. 4000 LPM 58 bar, 100 RPM/1-10 KNM.
Pumped 10m3 hi-vis pill and circulated 1 x b/u.
Flowchecked well for 10min, static.
POOH w/ clean-out BHA from 815 mmd to 81 mmd
Flowchecked well, static. Meanwhile removed PS-21 slips and installed masterbushing
L/d clean-out BHA. Cleaned and cleared drill floor.
Performed TBT for m/u new 13 3/8" EZSV plug and RT
P/u and m/u running tool and 13 3/8" EZSV plug
RIH w/ 13 3/8" EZSV BHA slowly until below CH. No obstructions seen.
Removed master bushing and installed PS-21 slips
RIH restricted w/ 13 3/8" EZSV BHA to 728 mmd, 2 min/std.
